reason: Since the installed release (39b2dd1) the schema did not change and the model gained what tells a governing session that a person settled what it waits on: the type AwaitedEnd, the branches Watching, Settled and Released of SessionUnitEvent, and the field settled of WaitOutcome.Ended. No stored row and no stored file is transformed. SessionUnitEvent is stored only in the units.jsonl of a session directory, which the new release reads as it is: the new branches are written by hosts of the new release alone. WaitOutcome is the output of cq wait and is stored nowhere. The generated Pi extension changed, so a project that uses Pi runs cq configure pi --replace after the update.
